# `Tls12ClientFlow` — the TLS 1.2 client handshake

## Documentation

`TlsClientHandshake` (`specs/tls-handshake.md`) continues as the TLS 1.2 client (RFC 5246, RFC 8422) when the
ServerHello selects TLS 1.2: it hands the rest of the handshake to `Tls12ClientFlow`, which shares the machine's
`TlsSession` (the record input and writer, the transcript, what was negotiated, the received data). It is `module`
code in `stdlib/`, so a program outside `stdlib/` cannot name it (E3088); the cases here are library-tier
(`<!-- tier: stdlib -->`) and reach it, and the test seams, as a stdlib source file does.

It follows the canra `tls12-handshake` contract. The ServerHello is checked against the downgrade sentinel when the
client offered TLS 1.3, and may carry only server_name, ec_point_formats, ALPN, extended_master_secret and
renegotiation_info. The server's chain is verified with `X509.verify` for the SNI host; an ECDHE-RSA suite needs an RSA
key and an ECDHE-ECDSA suite an ECDSA or Ed25519 one. The ServerKeyExchange group and signature scheme must have been
offered and fit the key (0x0403 needs a P-256 key and 0x0503 a P-384 key), and its signature, over both randoms and
the parameters, is verified with the scheme it names, RSA PKCS #1 v1.5 included. The client flight is one record:
after a CertificateRequest a Certificate and, with a certificate, a CertificateVerify over every handshake message
through the ClientKeyExchange, then the ClientKeyExchange. The master secret is the extended master secret (RFC 7627)
exactly when the ServerHello echoes extended_master_secret, and the RFC 5246 master secret otherwise; change_cipher_spec
and Finished follow in their own records, and the server's change_cipher_spec and Finished must follow in turn, the
Finished compared in constant time. A HelloRequest is skipped during the handshake and answered after it with the
warning alert no_renegotiation; a NewSessionTicket and any other handshake message are refused. An AES-GCM record the client opens is opened with the
explicit nonce it carries, and one the client seals carries the sequence number as its explicit nonce.

The vectors are the canra `tls12-handshake` contract: transcripts of the server of OpenSSL 3.0.13, the reference
client against the reference server, and the errors. A line prints the vector id and the canra expected object, the
Trace as compact JSON or the error name; the version is 771. Every one of the 32 canra vectors of this spec has a
case: the types leave none unspellable. Behaviour the vectors do not reach is pinned below them: 27 more transcripts
made with the canra reference server and checked by its reference client (a HelloRequest in the middle of the server
flight, records of every size, warning alerts, the record rules after the handshake, and the messages a TLS 1.2 client
refuses).

## Tests

<!-- test: tls12-handshake.replay-openssl-transcripts -->
<!-- tier: stdlib -->
Five transcripts OpenSSL 3.0.13 sent to the canra reference client replay byte for byte: every record the client sends is the record the vector lists, the ClientHello, the client key exchange flight, change_cipher_spec, Finished, application data and close_notify included, and the master secret equals the one in OpenSSL's key log. They are ECDHE-ECDSA with AES-128-GCM, ECDHE-RSA with ChaCha20-Poly1305 and with AES-256-GCM (the explicit nonces of OpenSSL's GCM records are not sequence numbers and open normally), a server without extended_master_secret, and OpenSSL asking for, and getting, the client's P-256 certificate.
```maxon
function digit(symbol Byte) returns Byte
	if symbol >= 0x61 'letter'
		return symbol - 0x57
	end 'letter'

	return symbol - 0x30
end 'digit'

function fromHex(hex String) returns ByteArray
	var bytes = ByteArray.create()
	var high = 0 as Byte
	var isHigh = true

	for symbol in hex.bytes() 'eachSymbol'
		if isHigh 'first'
			high = digit(symbol)
		end 'first' else 'second'
			bytes.push(high * 16 + digit(symbol))
		end 'second'

		isHigh = not isHigh
	end 'eachSymbol'

	return bytes
end 'fromHex'

function toHex(bytes ByteArray) returns String
	var text = ""

	for byte in bytes 'eachByte'
		text.append("{byte:02x}")
	end 'eachByte'

	return text
end 'toHex'

function secret(group TlsGroupCode, privateKey ByteArray) returns TlsKeySecret
	return try TlsKeySecret.create(group, privateKey: privateKey) otherwise panic("a canra private key was refused")
end 'secret'

typealias TextArray = Array with String

function joined(items TextArray) returns String
	var text = ""

	for (iter, item) in items.withIterator() 'eachItem'
		if iter.index() > 0 'separator'
			text.append(",")
		end 'separator'

		text.append(item)
	end 'eachItem'

	return "[{text}]"
end 'joined'

function renderRecords(records ByteArrays) returns String
	var texts = TextArray.create()

	for record in records 'eachRecord'
		texts.push("\"{toHex(record)}\"")
	end 'eachRecord'

	return joined(texts)
end 'renderRecords'

function renderVersion(negotiation TlsNegotiation) returns String
	return match negotiation 'negotiation'
		pending gives "null"
		accepted or
		keyed gives "772"
		accepted12 or
		keyed12 gives "771"
	end 'negotiation'
end 'renderVersion'

function renderSuite(negotiation TlsNegotiation) returns String
	return match negotiation 'negotiation'
		pending gives "null"
		accepted(suite) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
		keyed(suite, _) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
		accepted12(suite) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
		keyed12(suite, _) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
	end 'negotiation'
end 'renderSuite'

function renderGroup(negotiation TlsNegotiation) returns String
	return match negotiation 'negotiation'
		pending or
		accepted or
		accepted12 gives "null"
		keyed(_, group) gives "{group}"
		keyed12(_, group) gives "{group}"
	end 'negotiation'
end 'renderGroup'

function renderAlpn(alpn TlsAlpnChoice) returns String
	return match alpn 'alpn'
		absent gives "null"
		negotiated(protocol) gives "\"{toHex(protocol)}\""
	end 'alpn'
end 'renderAlpn'

function renderTrace(trace TlsReplayTrace) returns String
	let state = "connected" if trace.connected else "handshaking"

	return "\{\"state\":\"{state}\",\"version\":{renderVersion(trace.negotiation)},\"cipher_suite\":{renderSuite(trace.negotiation)},\"group\":{renderGroup(trace.negotiation)},\"alpn_protocol_hex\":{renderAlpn(trace.alpn)},\"outbound_records_hex\":{renderRecords(trace.outbound)},\"received_application_data_hex\":\"{toHex(trace.received)}\",\"peer_closed\":{trace.peerClosed},\"peer_authenticated\":{trace.peerAuthenticated}\}"
end 'renderTrace'

function report(id String, config TlsClientConfig, entropy TlsClientEntropy, peer TlsPeerAuthenticator, helloSource TlsClientHelloSource, inbound ByteArrays, writes ByteArrays, closeNotify bool)
	if let trace = try TlsClientReplay.run(config, entropy: entropy, peer: peer, helloSource: helloSource, inbound: inbound, writes: writes, closeNotify: closeNotify) 'replayed'
		print("{id} {renderTrace(trace)}\n")
	end 'replayed' else (failure) 'refused'
		print("{id} {failure}\n")
	end 'refused'
end 'report'
```

<!-- test: tls12-handshake.handshakes-by-suite-and-server-key -->
<!-- tier: stdlib -->
The reference server's TLS 1.2 handshakes: the default (ChaCha20-Poly1305 over ECDSA P-256 with X25519), a client limited to TLS 1.2, an ECDHE-RSA suite whose ServerKeyExchange is signed with RSA PKCS #1 v1.5, one signed with RSA-PSS over secp256r1, and server keys ECDSA P-384 and Ed25519 under the ECDHE-ECDSA suites.
```maxon
function digit(symbol Byte) returns Byte
	if symbol >= 0x61 'letter'
		return symbol - 0x57
	end 'letter'

	return symbol - 0x30
end 'digit'

function fromHex(hex String) returns ByteArray
	var bytes = ByteArray.create()
	var high = 0 as Byte
	var isHigh = true

	for symbol in hex.bytes() 'eachSymbol'
		if isHigh 'first'
			high = digit(symbol)
		end 'first' else 'second'
			bytes.push(high * 16 + digit(symbol))
		end 'second'

		isHigh = not isHigh
	end 'eachSymbol'

	return bytes
end 'fromHex'

function toHex(bytes ByteArray) returns String
	var text = ""

	for byte in bytes 'eachByte'
		text.append("{byte:02x}")
	end 'eachByte'

	return text
end 'toHex'

function secret(group TlsGroupCode, privateKey ByteArray) returns TlsKeySecret
	return try TlsKeySecret.create(group, privateKey: privateKey) otherwise panic("a canra private key was refused")
end 'secret'

typealias TextArray = Array with String

function joined(items TextArray) returns String
	var text = ""

	for (iter, item) in items.withIterator() 'eachItem'
		if iter.index() > 0 'separator'
			text.append(",")
		end 'separator'

		text.append(item)
	end 'eachItem'

	return "[{text}]"
end 'joined'

function renderRecords(records ByteArrays) returns String
	var texts = TextArray.create()

	for record in records 'eachRecord'
		texts.push("\"{toHex(record)}\"")
	end 'eachRecord'

	return joined(texts)
end 'renderRecords'

function renderVersion(negotiation TlsNegotiation) returns String
	return match negotiation 'negotiation'
		pending gives "null"
		accepted or
		keyed gives "772"
		accepted12 or
		keyed12 gives "771"
	end 'negotiation'
end 'renderVersion'

function renderSuite(negotiation TlsNegotiation) returns String
	return match negotiation 'negotiation'
		pending gives "null"
		accepted(suite) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
		keyed(suite, _) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
		accepted12(suite) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
		keyed12(suite, _) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
	end 'negotiation'
end 'renderSuite'

function renderGroup(negotiation TlsNegotiation) returns String
	return match negotiation 'negotiation'
		pending or
		accepted or
		accepted12 gives "null"
		keyed(_, group) gives "{group}"
		keyed12(_, group) gives "{group}"
	end 'negotiation'
end 'renderGroup'

function renderAlpn(alpn TlsAlpnChoice) returns String
	return match alpn 'alpn'
		absent gives "null"
		negotiated(protocol) gives "\"{toHex(protocol)}\""
	end 'alpn'
end 'renderAlpn'

function renderTrace(trace TlsReplayTrace) returns String
	let state = "connected" if trace.connected else "handshaking"

	return "\{\"state\":\"{state}\",\"version\":{renderVersion(trace.negotiation)},\"cipher_suite\":{renderSuite(trace.negotiation)},\"group\":{renderGroup(trace.negotiation)},\"alpn_protocol_hex\":{renderAlpn(trace.alpn)},\"outbound_records_hex\":{renderRecords(trace.outbound)},\"received_application_data_hex\":\"{toHex(trace.received)}\",\"peer_closed\":{trace.peerClosed},\"peer_authenticated\":{trace.peerAuthenticated}\}"
end 'renderTrace'

function report(id String, config TlsClientConfig, entropy TlsClientEntropy, peer TlsPeerAuthenticator, helloSource TlsClientHelloSource, inbound ByteArrays, writes ByteArrays, closeNotify bool)
	if let trace = try TlsClientReplay.run(config, entropy: entropy, peer: peer, helloSource: helloSource, inbound: inbound, writes: writes, closeNotify: closeNotify) 'replayed'
		print("{id} {renderTrace(trace)}\n")
	end 'replayed' else (failure) 'refused'
		print("{id} {failure}\n")
	end 'refused'
end 'report'
```

<!-- test: tls12-handshake.extended-master-secret-and-renegotiation -->
<!-- tier: stdlib -->
A server that does not echo extended_master_secret gets the RFC 5246 master secret, and a HelloRequest after the handshake is answered with the warning alert no_renegotiation (`01 64`) under the write keys while the connection continues.
```maxon
function digit(symbol Byte) returns Byte
	if symbol >= 0x61 'letter'
		return symbol - 0x57
	end 'letter'

	return symbol - 0x30
end 'digit'

function fromHex(hex String) returns ByteArray
	var bytes = ByteArray.create()
	var high = 0 as Byte
	var isHigh = true

	for symbol in hex.bytes() 'eachSymbol'
		if isHigh 'first'
			high = digit(symbol)
		end 'first' else 'second'
			bytes.push(high * 16 + digit(symbol))
		end 'second'

		isHigh = not isHigh
	end 'eachSymbol'

	return bytes
end 'fromHex'

function toHex(bytes ByteArray) returns String
	var text = ""

	for byte in bytes 'eachByte'
		text.append("{byte:02x}")
	end 'eachByte'

	return text
end 'toHex'

function secret(group TlsGroupCode, privateKey ByteArray) returns TlsKeySecret
	return try TlsKeySecret.create(group, privateKey: privateKey) otherwise panic("a canra private key was refused")
end 'secret'

typealias TextArray = Array with String

function joined(items TextArray) returns String
	var text = ""

	for (iter, item) in items.withIterator() 'eachItem'
		if iter.index() > 0 'separator'
			text.append(",")
		end 'separator'

		text.append(item)
	end 'eachItem'

	return "[{text}]"
end 'joined'

function renderRecords(records ByteArrays) returns String
	var texts = TextArray.create()

	for record in records 'eachRecord'
		texts.push("\"{toHex(record)}\"")
	end 'eachRecord'

	return joined(texts)
end 'renderRecords'

function renderVersion(negotiation TlsNegotiation) returns String
	return match negotiation 'negotiation'
		pending gives "null"
		accepted or
		keyed gives "772"
		accepted12 or
		keyed12 gives "771"
	end 'negotiation'
end 'renderVersion'

function renderSuite(negotiation TlsNegotiation) returns String
	return match negotiation 'negotiation'
		pending gives "null"
		accepted(suite) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
		keyed(suite, _) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
		accepted12(suite) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
		keyed12(suite, _) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
	end 'negotiation'
end 'renderSuite'

function renderGroup(negotiation TlsNegotiation) returns String
	return match negotiation 'negotiation'
		pending or
		accepted or
		accepted12 gives "null"
		keyed(_, group) gives "{group}"
		keyed12(_, group) gives "{group}"
	end 'negotiation'
end 'renderGroup'

function renderAlpn(alpn TlsAlpnChoice) returns String
	return match alpn 'alpn'
		absent gives "null"
		negotiated(protocol) gives "\"{toHex(protocol)}\""
	end 'alpn'
end 'renderAlpn'

function renderTrace(trace TlsReplayTrace) returns String
	let state = "connected" if trace.connected else "handshaking"

	return "\{\"state\":\"{state}\",\"version\":{renderVersion(trace.negotiation)},\"cipher_suite\":{renderSuite(trace.negotiation)},\"group\":{renderGroup(trace.negotiation)},\"alpn_protocol_hex\":{renderAlpn(trace.alpn)},\"outbound_records_hex\":{renderRecords(trace.outbound)},\"received_application_data_hex\":\"{toHex(trace.received)}\",\"peer_closed\":{trace.peerClosed},\"peer_authenticated\":{trace.peerAuthenticated}\}"
end 'renderTrace'

function report(id String, config TlsClientConfig, entropy TlsClientEntropy, peer TlsPeerAuthenticator, helloSource TlsClientHelloSource, inbound ByteArrays, writes ByteArrays, closeNotify bool)
	if let trace = try TlsClientReplay.run(config, entropy: entropy, peer: peer, helloSource: helloSource, inbound: inbound, writes: writes, closeNotify: closeNotify) 'replayed'
		print("{id} {renderTrace(trace)}\n")
	end 'replayed' else (failure) 'refused'
		print("{id} {failure}\n")
	end 'refused'
end 'report'
```

<!-- test: tls12-handshake.client-authentication -->
<!-- tier: stdlib -->
A CertificateRequest is answered with the client's Certificate and, in a CertificateVerify over every handshake message through the ClientKeyExchange, a signature under the first of the client's own schemes that the request lists and the key fits (ECDSA P-256, RSA PKCS #1 v1.5), with an empty Certificate when the client holds none, and with an empty Certificate again when no scheme is common.

```maxon
function digit(symbol Byte) returns Byte
	if symbol >= 0x61 'letter'
		return symbol - 0x57
	end 'letter'

	return symbol - 0x30
end 'digit'

function fromHex(hex String) returns ByteArray
	var bytes = ByteArray.create()
	var high = 0 as Byte
	var isHigh = true

	for symbol in hex.bytes() 'eachSymbol'
		if isHigh 'first'
			high = digit(symbol)
		end 'first' else 'second'
			bytes.push(high * 16 + digit(symbol))
		end 'second'

		isHigh = not isHigh
	end 'eachSymbol'

	return bytes
end 'fromHex'

function toHex(bytes ByteArray) returns String
	var text = ""

	for byte in bytes 'eachByte'
		text.append("{byte:02x}")
	end 'eachByte'

	return text
end 'toHex'

function secret(group TlsGroupCode, privateKey ByteArray) returns TlsKeySecret
	return try TlsKeySecret.create(group, privateKey: privateKey) otherwise panic("a canra private key was refused")
end 'secret'

typealias TextArray = Array with String

function joined(items TextArray) returns String
	var text = ""

	for (iter, item) in items.withIterator() 'eachItem'
		if iter.index() > 0 'separator'
			text.append(",")
		end 'separator'

		text.append(item)
	end 'eachItem'

	return "[{text}]"
end 'joined'

function renderRecords(records ByteArrays) returns String
	var texts = TextArray.create()

	for record in records 'eachRecord'
		texts.push("\"{toHex(record)}\"")
	end 'eachRecord'

	return joined(texts)
end 'renderRecords'

function renderVersion(negotiation TlsNegotiation) returns String
	return match negotiation 'negotiation'
		pending gives "null"
		accepted or
		keyed gives "772"
		accepted12 or
		keyed12 gives "771"
	end 'negotiation'
end 'renderVersion'

function renderSuite(negotiation TlsNegotiation) returns String
	return match negotiation 'negotiation'
		pending gives "null"
		accepted(suite) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
		keyed(suite, _) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
		accepted12(suite) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
		keyed12(suite, _) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
	end 'negotiation'
end 'renderSuite'

function renderGroup(negotiation TlsNegotiation) returns String
	return match negotiation 'negotiation'
		pending or
		accepted or
		accepted12 gives "null"
		keyed(_, group) gives "{group}"
		keyed12(_, group) gives "{group}"
	end 'negotiation'
end 'renderGroup'

function renderAlpn(alpn TlsAlpnChoice) returns String
	return match alpn 'alpn'
		absent gives "null"
		negotiated(protocol) gives "\"{toHex(protocol)}\""
	end 'alpn'
end 'renderAlpn'

function renderTrace(trace TlsReplayTrace) returns String
	let state = "connected" if trace.connected else "handshaking"

	return "\{\"state\":\"{state}\",\"version\":{renderVersion(trace.negotiation)},\"cipher_suite\":{renderSuite(trace.negotiation)},\"group\":{renderGroup(trace.negotiation)},\"alpn_protocol_hex\":{renderAlpn(trace.alpn)},\"outbound_records_hex\":{renderRecords(trace.outbound)},\"received_application_data_hex\":\"{toHex(trace.received)}\",\"peer_closed\":{trace.peerClosed},\"peer_authenticated\":{trace.peerAuthenticated}\}"
end 'renderTrace'

function report(id String, config TlsClientConfig, entropy TlsClientEntropy, peer TlsPeerAuthenticator, helloSource TlsClientHelloSource, inbound ByteArrays, writes ByteArrays, closeNotify bool)
	if let trace = try TlsClientReplay.run(config, entropy: entropy, peer: peer, helloSource: helloSource, inbound: inbound, writes: writes, closeNotify: closeNotify) 'replayed'
		print("{id} {renderTrace(trace)}\n")
	end 'replayed' else (failure) 'refused'
		print("{id} {failure}\n")
	end 'refused'
end 'report'
```

```maxon
function digit(symbol Byte) returns Byte
```

<!-- test: tls12-handshake.reference-handshakes-the-canra-vectors-do-not-list -->
<!-- tier: stdlib -->
Handshakes made with the canra reference server and checked by the canra reference client, for shapes the canra vectors do not reach: a HelloRequest between the server flight's messages, which is skipped and not hashed, a server flight in 64-byte records, a session id the server assigns, a warning alert before the change_cipher_spec and one after the handshake, which are ignored, application data written in fragments of 16384 bytes with an empty write between under AES-GCM and under ChaCha20-Poly1305, records after close_notify, which are ignored unread, and a client that offers no ALPN protocol, and a ServerHello without renegotiation_info, which is accepted.
```maxon
function digit(symbol Byte) returns Byte
	if symbol >= 0x61 'letter'
		return symbol - 0x57
	end 'letter'

	return symbol - 0x30
end 'digit'

function fromHex(hex String) returns ByteArray
	var bytes = ByteArray.create()
	var high = 0 as Byte
	var isHigh = true

	for symbol in hex.bytes() 'eachSymbol'
		if isHigh 'first'
			high = digit(symbol)
		end 'first' else 'second'
			bytes.push(high * 16 + digit(symbol))
		end 'second'

		isHigh = not isHigh
	end 'eachSymbol'

	return bytes
end 'fromHex'

function toHex(bytes ByteArray) returns String
	var text = ""

	for byte in bytes 'eachByte'
		text.append("{byte:02x}")
	end 'eachByte'

	return text
end 'toHex'

function secret(group TlsGroupCode, privateKey ByteArray) returns TlsKeySecret
	return try TlsKeySecret.create(group, privateKey: privateKey) otherwise panic("a canra private key was refused")
end 'secret'

typealias TextArray = Array with String

function joined(items TextArray) returns String
	var text = ""

	for (iter, item) in items.withIterator() 'eachItem'
		if iter.index() > 0 'separator'
			text.append(",")
		end 'separator'

		text.append(item)
	end 'eachItem'

	return "[{text}]"
end 'joined'

function renderRecords(records ByteArrays) returns String
	var texts = TextArray.create()

	for record in records 'eachRecord'
		texts.push("\"{toHex(record)}\"")
	end 'eachRecord'

	return joined(texts)
end 'renderRecords'

function renderVersion(negotiation TlsNegotiation) returns String
	return match negotiation 'negotiation'
		pending gives "null"
		accepted or
		keyed gives "772"
		accepted12 or
		keyed12 gives "771"
	end 'negotiation'
end 'renderVersion'

function renderSuite(negotiation TlsNegotiation) returns String
	return match negotiation 'negotiation'
		pending gives "null"
		accepted(suite) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
		keyed(suite, _) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
		accepted12(suite) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
		keyed12(suite, _) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
	end 'negotiation'
end 'renderSuite'

function renderGroup(negotiation TlsNegotiation) returns String
	return match negotiation 'negotiation'
		pending or
		accepted or
		accepted12 gives "null"
		keyed(_, group) gives "{group}"
		keyed12(_, group) gives "{group}"
	end 'negotiation'
end 'renderGroup'

function renderAlpn(alpn TlsAlpnChoice) returns String
	return match alpn 'alpn'
		absent gives "null"
		negotiated(protocol) gives "\"{toHex(protocol)}\""
	end 'alpn'
end 'renderAlpn'

function renderTrace(trace TlsReplayTrace) returns String
	let state = "connected" if trace.connected else "handshaking"

	return "\{\"state\":\"{state}\",\"version\":{renderVersion(trace.negotiation)},\"cipher_suite\":{renderSuite(trace.negotiation)},\"group\":{renderGroup(trace.negotiation)},\"alpn_protocol_hex\":{renderAlpn(trace.alpn)},\"outbound_records_hex\":{renderRecords(trace.outbound)},\"received_application_data_hex\":\"{toHex(trace.received)}\",\"peer_closed\":{trace.peerClosed},\"peer_authenticated\":{trace.peerAuthenticated}\}"
end 'renderTrace'
```

<!-- test: tls12-handshake.reference-refusals-the-canra-vectors-do-not-list -->
<!-- tier: stdlib -->
Refusals made with the canra reference server and checked by the canra reference client: a change_cipher_spec whose body is not 1, one after the handshake and one before the ServerHello, a ServerHelloDone that does not end its record, a KeyUpdate, which TLS 1.2 does not define, an empty Certificate, a ServerKeyExchange whose curve type is not named_curve, a compression method, a cipher suite the client did not offer and a TLS 1.3 suite, application data during the handshake, a fatal alert and a close_notify from the server before the handshake completes, an empty handshake record, and a protected record whose version is not 0x0303 or whose body is too short to hold a nonce and a tag.
```maxon
function digit(symbol Byte) returns Byte
	if symbol >= 0x61 'letter'
		return symbol - 0x57
	end 'letter'

	return symbol - 0x30
end 'digit'

function fromHex(hex String) returns ByteArray
	var bytes = ByteArray.create()
	var high = 0 as Byte
	var isHigh = true

	for symbol in hex.bytes() 'eachSymbol'
		if isHigh 'first'
			high = digit(symbol)
		end 'first' else 'second'
			bytes.push(high * 16 + digit(symbol))
		end 'second'

		isHigh = not isHigh
	end 'eachSymbol'

	return bytes
end 'fromHex'

function toHex(bytes ByteArray) returns String
	var text = ""

	for byte in bytes 'eachByte'
		text.append("{byte:02x}")
	end 'eachByte'

	return text
end 'toHex'

function secret(group TlsGroupCode, privateKey ByteArray) returns TlsKeySecret
	return try TlsKeySecret.create(group, privateKey: privateKey) otherwise panic("a canra private key was refused")
end 'secret'

typealias TextArray = Array with String

function joined(items TextArray) returns String
	var text = ""

	for (iter, item) in items.withIterator() 'eachItem'
		if iter.index() > 0 'separator'
			text.append(",")
		end 'separator'

		text.append(item)
	end 'eachItem'

	return "[{text}]"
end 'joined'

function renderRecords(records ByteArrays) returns String
	var texts = TextArray.create()

	for record in records 'eachRecord'
		texts.push("\"{toHex(record)}\"")
	end 'eachRecord'

	return joined(texts)
end 'renderRecords'

function renderVersion(negotiation TlsNegotiation) returns String
	return match negotiation 'negotiation'
		pending gives "null"
		accepted or
		keyed gives "772"
		accepted12 or
		keyed12 gives "771"
	end 'negotiation'
end 'renderVersion'

function renderSuite(negotiation TlsNegotiation) returns String
	return match negotiation 'negotiation'
		pending gives "null"
		accepted(suite) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
		keyed(suite, _) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
		accepted12(suite) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
		keyed12(suite, _) gives "{suite.rawValue}"
	end 'negotiation'
end 'renderSuite'

function renderGroup(negotiation TlsNegotiation) returns String
	return match negotiation 'negotiation'
		pending or
		accepted or
		accepted12 gives "null"
		keyed(_, group) gives "{group}"
		keyed12(_, group) gives "{group}"
	end 'negotiation'
end 'renderGroup'

function renderAlpn(alpn TlsAlpnChoice) returns String
	return match alpn 'alpn'
		absent gives "null"
		negotiated(protocol) gives "\"{toHex(protocol)}\""
	end 'alpn'
end 'renderAlpn'

function renderTrace(trace TlsReplayTrace) returns String
	let state = "connected" if trace.connected else "handshaking"

	return "\{\"state\":\"{state}\",\"version\":{renderVersion(trace.negotiation)},\"cipher_suite\":{renderSuite(trace.negotiation)},\"group\":{renderGroup(trace.negotiation)},\"alpn_protocol_hex\":{renderAlpn(trace.alpn)},\"outbound_records_hex\":{renderRecords(trace.outbound)},\"received_application_data_hex\":\"{toHex(trace.received)}\",\"peer_closed\":{trace.peerClosed},\"peer_authenticated\":{trace.peerAuthenticated}\}"
end 'renderTrace'

function report(id String, config TlsClientConfig, entropy TlsClientEntropy, peer TlsPeerAuthenticator, helloSource TlsClientHelloSource, inbound ByteArrays, writes ByteArrays, closeNotify bool)
	if let trace = try TlsClientReplay.run(config, entropy: entropy, peer: peer, helloSource: helloSource, inbound: inbound, writes: writes, closeNotify: closeNotify) 'replayed'
		print("{id} {renderTrace(trace)}\n")
	end 'replayed' else (failure) 'refused'
		print("{id} {failure}\n")
	end 'refused'
end 'report'
```
